spans.s:
शौण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं)
 1. Drunk, intoxicated.
 2. Fond of, addicted
to, (as liquor.)
 3. Skilful, (with a loc.) as in अक्षशौण्ड । f. (-ण्डी)
 1.
Long-pepper.
 2. Another sort, (Piper chavya.)
 E. शुण्डा spirituous
liquor, अण् aff.

शौण्डिक m. (-कः) A distiller and vender of spirituous liquors.
 f. (-की)
A female keeper of a tavern or dram-shop.
 E. शुण्डा spirits, ठञ् aff.

शौण्डिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
 1. Proud, haughty.
 2. Elevated, looking
upwards; more properly शौडीर, and शौठीर as above.
